Moments of You 💖

A Dream I Hold Close

Not a grand story. Just a simple, beautiful life with warmth, laughter, tea, deep talks, small celebrations, and a heart that chooses you every day.

I imagine peaceful mornings, making tea for you, sitting beside you, watching the sky slowly wake up while the world stays quiet for just a little longer.

I imagine protecting your smile, cheering for your dreams, listening to your stories, and being the person who makes your life feel lighter.

And if love is choosing one person again and again with honesty and care, then my heart already knows its answer.

The place I imagine the most

An ocean, a sunset, and only you. 🌅💖

If love ever needed a perfect background, it would be the ocean at sunset — because even the sky would pause for the moment I ask you to be mine.

I keep imagining this scene again and again: the waves moving softly, the sky painted in gold and pink, and me standing in front of you with nothing fake, nothing forced — just one true heart, one real promise, and one question meant only for you.

If I ever propose to you, I want it to be where the horizon meets forever, because that is exactly how I see my love for you — calm, deep, endless, and beautiful.

So under a sunrise or a sunset, in front of the ocean, I would still say the same thing with all my heart: Chandana, you are the only one I want beside me in every tomorrow. 💍✨

The most important section

Will you be mine? 💍

I do not want perfect words. I just want a true one: you matter to me, deeply and sincerely. I would love a chance to make you feel valued, respected, cared for, and loved.

So here is my heart, simple and honest: Will you say yes to us?
